candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position as Agentic AI Engineer. Turning prototypes into reliable, tested and well-documented solutions is exactly what I focused on in my latest project, an LLM application with a repeatable evaluation.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked with business data on SAP platforms as a Business Analyst and in analytics consulting.

achievements.impact: I built a RAG system over PDF manuals with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions; hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
I designed DocuMind's evaluation harness (hit rate, MRR, LLM judge, latency, cost) and shipped it with 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker
I used the evaluation to trace both wrong answers to chunk boundaries rather than to the model, and documented the findings in the project README

letter.problems_section: I would contribute Python code, connect model APIs, keep configurations and documentation up to date and build repeatable evaluations for quality, reliability and response times. I have not yet built agent workflows, and with my RAG, API and testing experience I can learn them quickly under your senior engineers.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Essen and can work 20 hours per week for the 6-month term, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
